events.name: Wednesday Kareoke
events.description:
Wednesday nights hit different at Azúcar. The Lounge lights go warm, the mic is live, and Alejandro's on host duty ready to hype up whoever grabs the spotlight next — first-timer or full-on diva, doesn't matter. Sing whatever you want. Butcher a ballad, nail your anthem, whatever — this crowd claps for all of it.

Free entry means zero excuses. Come solo, come with your people, order something cold from the bar and let the night build itself. There's no judgment here, just a room full of strangers turning into your biggest fans for three minutes at a time.

Get there early to snag your song, stay late for the surprise showstoppers. Every Wednesday, same energy: comfortable, loud, a little chaotic, completely yours.

events.name: Alice in Bass Land
events.description:
Forget the tea party — this rabbit hole drops straight into bass. Cabana Bass Productions takes over Main Floor on July 24th at 10PM and bends the room into something curiouser and curiouser: a warped, glitched-out wonderland where techno beats and heavy bass replace the Mad Hatter's riddles. Azúcar becomes the looking glass, and once you step through, there's no walking back out the same.

Expect a set that shifts like Wonderland itself — one minute hypnotic and creeping, the next full teeth-bared drop, Cabana Bass Productions steering the whole night like a Cheshire grin you can't quite trust. Lighting twists the room into something unreal, the crowd moves like they fell down their own rabbit hole, and every corner of Azúcar leans into the madness — sensorial, strange, electric.

This isn't a themed night. It's Alice in Wonderland if Wonderland ran on 140 BPM and never blinked. Come lose your logic, keep your rhythm — Main Floor turns into the maddest tea party this side of any looking glass.

events.name: Noche Latina
events.description:
Cynthia Marche is back, and she's bringing the heat. This queen has been keeping Latinx nightlife alive for years, and her show is the kind of spectacle that leaves you breathless—equal parts glamour, humor, and unabashed sensuality. She'll warm you up with a performance that'll make your abuela clutch her pearls (in the best way), then our DJ takes over and keeps the energy climbing all night.

Noche Latina is our monthly love letter to Latinx culture, and it lives in the Ranchero Room—packed, pulsing, unapologetic. The music is pure Latino heat: reggaeton, salsa, bachata, cumbia, whatever makes your hips move. The vibe is provocative without pretense. The crowd is here to feel alive, to laugh, to move, to belong.

Come early, stay late, bring your crew. Cynthia's got jokes and pipes for days. The DJ's got the soundtrack to your night. We've got the drinks and the space where you can be exactly as spicy as you want to be.

events.name: Night of Kings

Jen — known for seductive lace and leather performances — takes the stage as a king for the first time. Beah debuts after tearing up our amateur competitions. Cherry Pop hosts the night, keeping the temperature exactly where it needs to be. Sharp fits, killer moves, performances that hit different. The vibe: intimate but electric. The mood: everyone's here to witness, to cheer, to feel something.

events.name: Heels Dance Class with Frankie
events.description:
Heels on, walls down — Frankie's teaching you how to move like you own the room. This is a step-by-step class built for beginners and anyone ready to level up, no experience necessary and every body welcome to strut in.

We start with the fundamentals: posture, balance, the technique that makes heelwork look effortless even when it isn't. Then comes the stretch — crucial, don't skip it — loosening you up so your hips, spine, and confidence all move together. By the end of the hour you'll have a fully choreographed routine down, sharp enough to show off and fun enough to want to do it again.

Frankie brings the energy of a big sister who won't let you quit and won't let you fall — patient, hype, and a little bit fierce. Expect sweat, laughter, a few wobbles, and a room full of people cheering each other on instead of comparing.

Main Floor, Thursday July 30 at 6pm. Come stretch, come sweat, come strut — Azúcar's floor is yours for the taking.

events.name: Rosie’s Birthday Bash
events.description:
The candles are lit, the glitter's already in the air, and Azúcar smells like rum and rosas — because tonight belongs to Rosie. Step onto the Main Floor and feel the room hum before the first beat even drops, todo el mundo aquí por una sola razón: to celebrate somebody amazing.

The drag show hits first — bold, brillante, dripping with birthday energy, queens serving looks made just for this night. Then the lights dip low for a secret guest performer nobody's talking about — the kind of surprise that makes the whole room lean in, hold their breath, y después explotar. No spoilers. Just trust the mystery.

After that? Rosie takes the booth and the floor becomes hers — sudorosa, dorada, alive. Expect trivia nobody can win without knowing her favorite drink order, silly mini-games with real prizes, and dancing that stretches long past midnight, cuerpo a cuerpo under string lights and bass.

The room pulses with dark glamour: think candlelight meets confetti, sin meets celebration.

events.name: Amature Drag Pageant
events.description:
Three rounds. One crown. Zero mercy — pero con mucho amor. Azúcar's Main Floor turns into the pageant runway of your dreams on August 19th, as Abele Fantasy takes the mic to host the Amature Drag Pageant, an open-category showcase for talent, glamour, and belleza in every shape it comes in.

Round one: talent — sing it, lip-sync it, dance it, act it, we don't care, just bring the fuego. Round two: ballroom / gown portion, gender-inclusive por diseño, because elegance isn't one silhouette — wear the gown, the suit, the fantasy, whatever makes you feel like royalty. Round three: beauty, defined on your own terms, drag como tú lo entiendes, tu belleza, tu regla.

The room will be electric — categoría is served, the crowd is loud, and every contestant walks in a legend already. Sponsors are stacking a prize basket loaded with goodies, fresh makeup, and — of course — the crown itself, waiting for whoever brings the most heart and heat to that stage.

Grab a seat, grab a drink, and get ready to scream for your favorites. Whether you're competing or cheering, este es tu momento — full glam, full drama, full corazón.
